title: Seppic strengthens its natural cosmetics business with Minasolve acquisition
summary: Minasolve, a pioneer in green chemistry specializing in natural preservation boosters for cosmetic products, particularly 100% bio-based glycols, is joining Seppic, a subsidiary of the Air Liquide Group. Founded in 2007 and a subsidiary of the Minafin Group, Minasolve specializes in upcycling agricultural residues (such as sugarcane bagasse) and transforming them into high-performance cosmetic ingredients. Minasolve relies on unique technological processes protected by 12 patent families.... - Industry buzz
